dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular, jagged-edged 'C' and 'O' shaped light-colored geometries on a dark-grey dorsal background, displaying sharp intensity transitions from dark perimeters to lighter interiors.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of saturated, high-intensity white pixel clusters concentrated on the lower lateral flank; low-density distribution of small, discrete, low-intensity dark blobs along the dorsal midline.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of three primary dorsal macro-annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle spanning the mid-dorsal to posterior-dorsal region.

other_distinctive_markers: High-intensity light-colored facial mask extending from the anterior muzzle to the circumorbital region, contrasting with the lower-intensity crown.
